description.value:
Veeva Systems is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences to help companies work in a more efficient and connected way. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website .

Crossix is positioned at the center of big data, innovative technology, media, and life sciences. Our mission is to empower life sciences companies with the data and insights they need to drive patient and provider marketing effectiveness and, ultimately, better patient outcomes. As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader.

The Role

We are hiring recent university graduates to grow the next generation of data analysts through our Analytics Development Program .

The Marketing Data Analyst (MDA) is a member of the internal analytics team focused on product analytics. This team’s primary function is to produce the analytical reports that are incorporated into Veeva Crossix products and shared with customers.

What this role is (and isn’t):

What it IS : A data analytics role. You will be part of our internal analytics team, focusing on backend report generation, quality control, and pressure-testing results. Using SQL, Excel, and our proprietary coding language, you will link marketing data to health data, transforming large datasets into core analytical reports embedded in Veeva Crossix products. Your work will be used to generate the insights our customers use to make business decisions.

What it IS NOT: This is not a client-facing consulting role. If you want to spend your days in external client meetings, presenting slide decks, and advising on marketing strategies, check out the Client Services Associate track. This is also not a software engineering role - your focus is on data logic, manipulation, and insights, not building software architecture.

This role is part of Generation Veeva , and as such you can expect:

A “learn by doing” environment with challenging and impactful work, where you will be expected to learn quickly and deliver early

A collaborative work environment where you will work closely with many levels of our team, from other early-career professionals through senior leaders

Mentorship and continuous professional development opportunities, aiding in your immediate and long-term success at Veeva

The anticipated start date is July 2027.

The Analytics Development Program offers two distinct paths. Please review our other track, the Client Services Associate role, to choose the best fit for your skills and interests.

We welcome you to apply to all roles that align with your skills and interests. See all open opportunities here: Generation Veeva Careers

What You'll Do
Produce Analytics Reports: Own the end-to-end execution, rigorous quality control, and timely delivery of high-value, recurring analytical reports across a large portfolio.

Link Complex Datasets: Connect marketing exposure data to massive, transactional healthcare datasets. Your data manipulation will provide the analytical foundation that helps pharmaceutical and life sciences companies optimize their marketing efforts and ultimately improve patient outcomes.

Formulate Analytical Hypotheses: Transform complex client questions into hypotheses that are testable using SQL, Excel, and Crossix’s proprietary analytical coding language.

Partner Internally with Client Services: Communicate the technical results and methodology of marketing campaign analyses to our Client Services teams, acting as the subject-matter expert on the underlying data logic.

Master Modern Data Tools: Leverage a robust toolkit including SQL, advanced Excel, data visualization suites, and internal platforms to clean, manipulate, and present data effectively.

REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for graduates who meet the following requirements:
Technical Foundation: Intermediate proficiency in SQL, Python, or a comparable coding language. You have a natural comfort with data structures and a knack for logical, step-by-step problem-solving.

High Drive & Performance: A self-starter with a track record of excellence who thrives in a demanding and dynamic environment, and is hungry for rapid professional growth.

Meticulous Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision and a commitment to rigorous quality control. You take pride in catching small errors before they impact the final product.

Effective Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively share technical insights and methodology with our internal client services teams.

Academic Excellence: Bachelor’s degree (any major) with a 3.0 – 4.0 GPA, demonstrating the intellectual curiosity, time management, and work ethic necessary for a high-performance analytics career.

Experience Level: This role is designed for upcoming or recent graduates with 0–2 years of post-grad full-time work experience.

Location & Presence: You live within about a 45-60 minute commute of our NYC office (or plan to be by your start date) and look forward to collaborating with the team on-site 4 days a week.

Unwavering Integrity: Veeva is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a “do the right thing” company. We hold ourselves to high ethical standards and expect honesty and integrity from every team member.

THE PROCESS | Our process is different from most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
Application & Assessment: You submit your resume, responses to a few short application questions, and complete a brief online assessment, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.

Application Response (Within 1 Week): We review every application thoroughly. Within about one week of submission, we will notify you via email whether we’d like to move you to the next stage.

Initial Interview: You will participate in a 60-minute job interview with a senior member of our team.

Case Interview: If we proceed following your initial interview, you will complete an analytics case exercise. This will be a live demonstration of your skills, with no prework required.

Final Decision (Within 1 Week): Within about one week of completing your case exercise, we will either extend an official offer or let you know that we are not moving forward.

Your Decision (2 Weeks): If extended an offer, you will have two weeks to make your final decision. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview for other roles would be an ethical violation in our view.

Perks & Benefits
Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance

Flexible PTO and company paid holidays

Retirement programs

1% charitable giving program

Compensation
Starting base pay: $82,500

Work Authorization: Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. Veeva does not provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, OPT, or TN status) for this employment position.

[Known](https://known.is/) is what happens when a data science firm and a creative agency stop arguing and start collaborating. We were built from scratch with PhD data scientists and award-winning creatives working on the same briefs, from day one. That structure earned us an Ad Age #3 A-List ranking, back-to-back Data & Insights Agency of the Year wins, plus Emmys, Cannes Lions, Clios, and Effies across clients in finance, tech, entertainment, consumer goods, and real estate. We're distributed across the U.S. and unapologetically ambitious.

If you're tired of choosing between doing smart work and doing creative work, you'll fit right in here.

**BUT ENOUGH ABOUT US, LET'S TALK ABOUT YOU**

About the role:

Known is seeking Senior Data Analysts to work in our Skeptic and Data Consulting practices. This highly technical position involves advanced analytics, machine learning, and statistics. This is a hybrid role based in New York City.

The Data Consulting practice solves various challenging marketing and business problems for our clients, who span some of the world’s most famous brands across media, tech, entertainment, consumer products, and more.  Known’s Skeptic team builds the tools that power Known’s media buying practice and elevate our clients' media campaigns. Our work ranges from predictive modeling/optimization to infrastructure development, and Skeptic’s data scientists and engineers are challenged daily to push the limits of advanced advertising.

Senior Data Analysts work closely with PhD-level data scientists, engineers, and other analysts, quickly learning the skills needed to deliver exploratory analyses, on-the-fly reports, machine learning results, data quality strategies, or production code.

Being a Senior Data Analyst at Known is a unique opportunity to take on increasing levels of responsibility, with our analysts often becoming expert data scientists, engineers, or team leaders.

## **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Build and maintain tools**

* Develop, deploy, and maintain tools for marketing applications, including our [existing suite](https://known.is/skeptic), and help teams adopt them
* Improve analytics code, dashboards, and reporting

**Analyze and automate**

* Be part of [MOAs](https://known.is/moa): create and validate analyses in SQL, Python, and proprietary tools, and bring your own
* Automate recurring marketing analyses for media buying teams
* Improve data and code quality and troubleshoot data issues

**Work with clients and the team**

* Plan projects and participate in research meetings with teammates
* Present results to colleagues and clients, and answer their questions promptly and thoughtfully
* Contribute to deliverables (documents, code, slides) and to Known’s strategy

## **WHO YOU ARE AND WHAT YOU HAVE**

**What you need**

* A BS/BA degree from an accredited college or university. STEM degrees are preferred
* At least two years of experience in analytics, advertising, ad tech, or media
* Regular experience using Python (or similar) and SQL
* Based in the New York City area (this is a hybrid role)
* A willingness to learn foundational knowledge and skills rapidly
* Abundant intellectual curiosity and integrity
* A desire to work on challenging problems that require flexibility in approach - everything from on-the-fly analytics to statistics, big data, machine learning, and mathematical algorithms (but not alone!).

**How you work**

* Superb communication and presentation skills, with both technical and non-technical audiences
* You translate business challenges into quantitative problems and solve them with whatever method fits, which may not be machine learning
* You understand what LLMs and generative AI can and cannot do, including the ethical considerations
* You own projects and take them to completion
* You hold your work and others’ to a high standard for quality and accuracy

**Nice to have**

* Experience in advertising or advertising technology
* Experience working on a tech team, including cloud technologies and version control
* Experience multi-tasking in a fast-paced environment
* Experience working directly with clients
* Experience with predictive analytics or machine learning

**SOME OF OUR PERKS**

* Unlimited paid time off
* 401k with company matching and no vesting period
* Annual bonuses
* Generous medical plan
* Paid parental leave

**ONE LAST THING TO ASK YOURSELF**

All this might sound great, but you’re probably still wondering, “Would I be a good fit for Known?” or “Would Known be a good fit for me?” Our culture is propped up by four values that we aspire to every day: We are one team. We see the good. We never stop learning. There’s always a better way. At Known we are setting out to build something more than just a company. We are building a legacy filled with exceptionally talented people with a kaleidoscope of backgrounds, experiences, and origin stories who feel encouraged and empowered to bring their whole selves to work, and to partner with us in molding and shaping our culture through our values.

Job Description
Asset Management - Data Analyst, Private Markets Data Products (Vice President)
Job summary
As a Data Analyst on the Asset Management Private Markets Data Products team, you will serve as the Alternatives data subject-matter expert for the domain. You will help build out the Private Markets data model and the semantic layer that sits on top of it, standardizing definitions and making data consistently usable by both people and AI. Your primary focus will be expanding Alternatives datasets to include the business-critical attributes that support core business processes and downstream consumption. You will enable client and investor reporting, oversee business-as-usual data issues and data quality, help scale the platform, and ensure data is delivered accurately to the appropriate Systems of Record (SORs). This is a hands-on, analytical role that depends on sustained collaboration with internal and external partners to understand the underlying businesses, the data they produce, and how consumers need to use it.
Job responsibilities
+ Serve as the Alternatives data subject-matter expert for the Private Markets domain, acting as the reference point for what a data element means, where it originates, how it behaves, and how it should be used.
+ Build out the Private Markets data model alongside engineering and architecture partners, defining entities, attributes, relationships, grain, and lineage, including net-new datasets where no prior model exists.
+ Develop and maintain the semantic layer over the data model, covering standardized business definitions, derived metrics, and consistent vocabularies, so that data is directly consumable by people, BI tools, and AI agents without re-interpretation.
+ Expand Alternatives datasets to capture business-critical attributes, sequencing coverage by the core business processes and downstream consumption each attribute unlocks.
+ Partner with engineering in an agile framework to plan and deliver strategic work: shaping epics and stories in JIRA, authoring and reviewing data requirements and mapping specifications, answering domain questions through development, and participating in UAT and control testing.
+ Systematically connect vendors, fund administrators, custodians, general partners, and other external sources into the platform, onboarding feeds in a repeatable way that continues to build out the Alternatives data core rather than accumulating one-off extracts, and working with those partners to interpret data, validate it, and resolve discrepancies at source.
+ Partner closely with the Chief Data Office to ensure the domain adheres to firmwide and Asset Management data governance and data strategy principles, covering data ownership, classification, quality standards, documentation expectations, and the domain's contribution to enterprise data priorities.
+ Enable client, investor, and management reporting by translating reporting requirements into data requirements, sourcing the underlying attributes, and validating outputs against expected results.
+ Own business-as-usual data issue management and data quality: triage and root-cause issues, define and monitor business data quality rules and thresholds, drive remediation with source and platform teams, and surface recurring themes for structural fixes.
+ Ensure data is delivered accurately and completely to the appropriate Systems of Record, and support migration from legacy sources to strategic SORs including mapping, reconciliation, and cutover validation.
+ Profile and analyze data hands-on to test hypotheses, size gaps, and quantify impact, providing the evidence that informs prioritization, roadmap, and design decisions.
+ Maintain domain documentation covering data dictionaries, business glossary entries, data quality rules, lineage, and catalog and metadata entries, so the domain stays self-describing as it grows.
+ Help scale the platform by identifying reusable patterns and standards rather than one-off fixes as additional businesses, asset classes, and datasets onboard.
+ Required qualifications, skills and capabilities
+ Extensive experience in data-focused roles such as data analysis, data management, data operations, or business and data product analysis, within financial services or a comparably complex data environment.
+ Deep, practical knowledge of private markets or alternatives data and the businesses that produce it. We will also consider an exceptional data analyst from an adjacent domain who can demonstrate they learn a new business quickly and thoroughly.
+ Experience acting as the primary data expert for a business area or dataset, including owning its definitions and documentation and fielding questions from partner teams.
+ Strong hands-on analytical skills, comfortable working directly with data to profile, reconcile, and investigate, using SQL or equivalent query and analysis tooling.
+ Experience translating business needs into data requirements: attributes, definitions, models, and mapping specifications that engineers can build from without ambiguity.
+ Rigor and ownership around data quality, with a track record of driving issues to root cause and to closure across teams rather than handing them off.
+ Strong written communication, able to document definitions and decisions clearly enough that others can rely on them without a conversation.
+ Collaborative operator who works effectively across business, operations, technology, and external partners, and can move between detailed data work and senior stakeholder discussion.
+ Comfort with ambiguity and greenfield work, able to bring structure where no model, dictionary, or precedent yet exists.
Preferred qualifications, skills and capabilities
+ Subject matter expertise in private markets data domains including capital calls and distributions, waterfalls and carried interest, NAV and performance, commitments and unfunded capital, investor, fund and entity structures, and deal and portfolio company data.
+ Experience supporting Real Estate, Infrastructure, Private Credit, Private Equity, or Alternative Solutions businesses.
+ Technical depth is a strong plus: advanced SQL, Python, cloud data platforms such as AWS and Snowflake, transformation tooling, and data catalog or lineage solutions.
+ Aptitude for AI tooling, particularly applied to data modeling and to building reusable skills and agents, with a readiness to adopt new and innovative tools to execute on deliverables and strategic projects.
+ Experience building or contributing to a semantic layer, metrics store, or business glossary that serves BI, self-service analytics, or AI consumption.
+ Experience with fund administrator, general partner, custodian, or vendor data feeds and the reconciliation and validation that comes with them.
+ Experience supporting client or investor reporting within an asset manager.
+ Familiarity with data governance concepts including data ownership, reference data and MDM, metadata, data contracts, and controls.
+ High aptitude with agile collaboration tools such as Confluence and JIRA, and experience working alongside a product owner and an engineering squad.

- Reporting for multiple audiences — you know the difference between what a frontline manager needs and what a CFO needs, and you build accordingly

- Strong data storytelling — you don't just present numbers, you write the narrative

- Comfort operating solo — you don't need a team around you to deliver, and you don't need a ticket to tell you what to look at

- Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tooling

The Role:
The Data Analyst - Credit Risk Management & Counterparty Risk (Client & Markets Data) role sits within Citi's Enterprise Data group, a core part of the firm's first line of defense for wholesale and counterparty credit risk management. This seasoned professional applies in-depth analytical and subject-matter expertise to examine credit risk, liquidity, and trade/reference data, identifying patterns and trends that inform business planning and risk decision-making. The role involves close collaboration with technology teams to design and deliver remediation solutions for data issues, as well as direct engagement with data consumers to understand requirements and resolve concerns logged in the DCRM tool. The individual will regularly take on informal or formal leadership responsibilities, coach junior team members, and exercise sound judgment in balancing complex, sometimes conflicting inputs from multiple stakeholders. Ultimately, this person contributes to Citi's broader data transformation efforts by ensuring timely, accurate, and complete data that supports business-as-usual operations, risk analysis, and regulatory reporting.

Responsibilities
Analyzes Credit Risk Management, Liquidity Management, and related data sets, including data sourced from front office trade capture systems and reference data sources. Gathers operational data from various cross-functional stakeholders to examine past business performance. Identifies data patterns and trends. Provides insights to enhance business decision-making in areas such as business planning, process improvement, and solution assessment. Discusses data issues with technology teams to design and deliver remediation solutions. Discusses data requirements and the impact of data issues with data consumers, as raised in the DCRM tool. Performs administrative updates of Data Concerns within the DCRM tool to maintain accurate, current status tracking. Recommends actions to support future developments and strategic business opportunities. Recommends enhancements to operational policies based on data findings. May be involved in exploratory data analysis, confirmatory data analysis, and/or qualitative analysis. Translates data into consumer or customer behavioral insights to drive targeting and segmentation strategies. Communicates findings clearly and effectively to business partners and senior leaders. Continuously improves processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities. Works closely with internal and external business partners to build, implement, track, and improve decision strategies. Appropriately assesses risk in all business decisions, with particular consideration for the firm's reputation. Safeguards Citigroup, its clients, and its assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations. Adheres to Citi policy and applies sound ethical judgment regarding personal conduct and business practices. Escalates, manages, and reports control issues with transparency.
Qualifications
4-5 years' experience performing data analytics with financial markets data and products. At least 1 year of experience in SQL or Python scripting. Hands-on Experience leveraging tools such as Excel, Tableau, SQL and Python to perform data analysis. Understanding of how firms manage Credit and Market Risk for trading book activity. Knowledge of Financial markets structure and products, including over-the-counter derivatives, securities financing transactions, exchange-traded derivatives and cash trading. Comfortable working with large data sets and able to demonstrate a firm understanding of logical data structures and analysis techniques. Data tracing, Data mining, visualization, analysis – identifying patterns/trends, exploratory data analysis, root cause analysis, machine learning & predictive analytics. Experience interacting across multiple teams globally and influencing diverse groups of stakeholders Strong sense of urgency and ability to manage multiple competing priorities while delivering results quickly and efficiently. Prior experience with a focus in financial services analytics. Effective written and verbal communication skills. Ability to present to business partners and/or leaders to gain approvals. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Demonstrated ability to work successfully both as a self-starter and successfully within a team environment.
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent relevant experience. Master's degree preferred.

National Grid is hiring a Senior Data Analyst for our NY Electric and Data Systems department in Syracuse, NY.
Every day we deliver safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses. We are there when people need us the most. We connect people to the energy they need for the lives they live.
The pace of change in society and our industry is accelerating and our expertise and track record puts us in an unparalleled position to shape the sustainable future of our industry. This requires us to deliver on our promises and always look for new opportunities to grow, both ourselves and our business.
Job Purpose
National Grid is committed to Digital Transformation and is building a best-in-class utility of the future. The NY Electric Data and Systems team is responsible for delivering solutions which support a data driven organization and advance National Grid toward our digital future.
The core function of this role is to help the organization utilize data to facilitate sound decisions that deliver safe, reliable, clean and affordable electric power to our customers.
This analyst will work closely with business teams in Operations, Asset Management and Engineering, as well as IT, digital product and platform teams. This analyst will bring the capability to create data insights form data sets, reports and dashboards; conduct analysis independently and in partnership with business teams; assist in the enhancement of existing digital products and the design of new ones; and help close the quality gaps by defining logic and requirements that meet our business needs. Tasks will include solution delivery, data and process mapping, and data change management to secure the reliability and safety of National Grids information.

+ Conducting rigorous analysis of data quality and analytics use cases, collaboration with subject matter experts and performing comprehensive technical evaluations.
+ Constructing reports and data visualizations which support the business processes.
+ Identifying, evaluating, presenting and recommending options to all levels of leadership(along with effort/impact/risk of each).
+ Develop and apply domain knowledge and work as a fully engaged member of the NY Electric Data & Systems team.
+ Provide data guidance and support to digital projects and initiatives.
+ Support preparation of materials for communications, training and key stakeholder readouts.
+ Ability to quickly understand business and data processes, identify customer pain points and help translate business needs into solutions.
+ Ability to take a roughly defined approach or hypotheses, identify core intentions and ramifications, and use these insights to refine business assumptions.
+ Ability to perform data analytics (including SQL knowledge) and creation of reports/dashboards to communicate meaningful insights.
+ Ability to assist with change management and product rollout plans, including presentating materials to senior stakeholders, training material development, and communications plans.
+ Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
+ Ability to effectively partner with stakeholders and build relationships.
Conduct data quality assements and root cause analysis of data issues. Work with business and IT stakeholders to implement necessary changes and improvements.
+ Develop details data process maps and documentation (current and to-be state) for NY Electric workflows and projects.

+ Ability to communicate to stakeholders at all levels in the organization.
+ Work well in a team.

+ Bachelors degree in a STEM discipline with 4 years of related experience, however candidates with equivalent experience will be considered.
+ Practical experience with data models, relational databases and development of SQL series.
+ Experience conducting structured business analysis and generation of well defined requirements.
+ Experience with complete data flows and relationship to business process.
+ Knowledge of digital product implementation fundamentals, digital ways of working, and Agile methodologies.
+ Demonstrated effectiveness communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Job Requirements
SUMMARY
The Disney DTC Sports & ESPN Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst who will be an exceptional addition to our team. You will be responsible for turning data into information, information into insights, and insights into key business decisions that steer the strategic direction of ESPN's direct-to-consumer product strategy. The right person for this role has exceptional analytical capabilities, thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves problem-solving, is a good communicator, and is passionate about high quality digital product experiences.
You will play a key role in building out ESPN's product analytics function from the ground up, serving as a dedicated point of contact and thought partner for the ESPN product and product engineering teams. You will lead the foundational work streams for ESPN app measurement: standing up a governed, centralized source of truth for ESPN app performance metrics — canonical definitions, consistent logic, and numbers the business can align on — and building the self-serve tooling that lets stakeholders not only see that a KPI moved, but locate what drove the movement. You will also be the experimentation partner to the product organization, shaping how ESPN app features are tested and how those results are read.
This role is hands-on and technical. You will design and maintain the aggregation logic and metric tables that sit underneath executive reporting, and you will be expected to defend the numbers you publish — including the measurement caveats that travel with them.
RESPONSIBILITIES
• Own and evolve the source-of-truth metric layer for ESPN app performance — headline KPIs (DAU, time spent, watch minutes), their definitions, their dimensional breakouts, and the documented caveats that accompany each
• Design and maintain pre-aggregated metric tables and serving views in Snowflake, and the scheduled pipelines that refresh them, ensuring metrics are correct at every level of aggregation
• Build the monitoring and decomposition logic that identifies when a KPI movement is real and where it is concentrated — baselines, significance thresholds, contribution ranking, and volume-versus-mix splits
• Distinguish genuine behavioral movements from measurement artifacts and instrumentation breakage, and partner with product engineering to close the analytics QA gap on client releases
• Build dashboards and self-serve tooling in Looker that reduce stakeholder reliance on ad-hoc analyst pulls
• Conduct analyses using SQL and Python to access and manipulate multivariate product and behavioral data, and ideate new metrics and analytical approaches for in-app user behavior
• Partner with product and engineering on experimentation end-to-end — translating a product question into a testable hypothesis, selecting primary and guardrail metrics, sizing and powering the test, validating assignment and exposure, analyzing the readout, and diagnosing what happened when a test misbehaves or reads flat
• Reconcile ESPN app metrics across teams and systems, and drive alignment on definitions with Research, Data Product, and data engineering partners
• Serve as a dedicated point of contact and thought partner for ESPN product and product engineering teams, taking projects end-to-end from vague business need to socialized insight
• Communicate results through compelling data storytelling to product leadership and the broader ESPN business
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
• Degree in an analytical area such as Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Economics, or equivalent practical experience
• 5+ years of relevant work experience in analytics, product analytics, and/or business intelligence
• Advanced SQL — able to read and write complex analytical queries, and to reason about correctness of aggregation logic (for example, why a distinct-count metric cannot be summed across segments)
• Working proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, and pipeline work
• Practical understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling — how metric tables are structured, refreshed, and served to downstream consumers
• Applied statistical judgment: constructing baselines, assessing whether a change is meaningful versus noise, and handling seasonality and day-of-week effects
• Hands-on product experimentation experience — designing and executing A/B and multivariate tests, analyzing results (significance, confidence intervals, minimum detectable effect, guardrail metrics), and diagnosing common failure modes such as sample ratio mismatch, assignment or exposure leakage, interaction effects, and novelty decay
• Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, or equivalent) coupled with strong storytelling skills for technical and non-technical audiences
• Experience taking vague requirements and manipulating them into polished final products
• Strong and effective communication and presentation skills
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Hands-on experience with digital clickstream or behavioral analytics data (Adobe Analytics, Amplitude, or similar), including its identity and measurement limitations
• Experience with Databricks, PySpark, or comparable large-scale data processing
• Experience establishing metric governance — canonical definitions, reconciliation across teams, and change management on metric logic
• Experience with an experimentation platform (Optimizely, Statsig, Amplitude Experiment, or in-house) and with scaling experimentation practice across product teams
• Familiarity with identity resolution across web, app, and connected TV, and the practical consequences of cookie-based measurement
• Prior experience in Sports or Media/Entertainment
